questions.question: What is wrong with passing Tradeline listings straight into the core?
options: Tradeline's codes and names would spread through the core, so their changes break our code.
questions.explanation: Letting another model in unchanged makes it part of yours. The anticorruption layer keeps it at the border.

questions.question: A listing arrives with sector code ZZZ. What should the adapter do?
options: Raise an exception and stop the import
Return a company with no directory hint
questions.explanation: An unknown code means "no information". Guessing, or using Other, would invent a claim the partner never made.

questions.question: In the context map, how does the review team relate to the Company Enricher?
options: It is upstream and supplies data.
It is translated by the anticorruption layer.
It is downstream and works from our results, in our language.
questions.explanation: Reviewers consume our results and share our language, so no translation is needed between them and us.
